color.label: Colored faces
color.observed: Nets can share a silhouette and differ only in visible corner assignment.
color.construct: Keep the colored corner visible; move or swap two of its faces on one valid net. Compare folded cyclic order for every choice.

pips.label: pips on the unfolded faces
pips.observed: The same face pattern can meet the same neighbors at a different orientation.
pips.construct: Place a dot pair on a face visible in the shown corner; contrast two candidate nets with matching identities. Require a unique matching or failing net under the requested polarity.

lines.label: lines on the unfolded faces
lines.observed: The same face pattern can meet the same neighbors at a different orientation.
lines.construct: Place parallel stripes on a face visible in the shown corner; contrast two candidate nets with matching identities. Require a unique matching or failing net under the requested polarity.

mosaic.label: mosaic on the unfolded faces
mosaic.observed: The same face pattern can meet the same neighbors at a different orientation.
mosaic.construct: Place a colored dot cluster on a face visible in the shown corner; contrast two candidate nets with matching identities. Require a unique matching or failing net under the requested polarity.
